notEditableMessage: This template version is no longer editable.
listDescription: Versioned, publishable interview definitions — one per Position + Stage (plan §22, ADR-008).
noPositionsMessage: Create a Position first — a template belongs to a Position + Interview Stage.
interviewLanguageHelp: The language questions, expected answers, and rubrics are generated and conducted in — independent of the application's own display language. Fixed once the template is created, like the Interview Stage above.
templateNamePlaceholder: e.g. QA Automation Engineer — Technical Interview
criticalCheckboxLabel: Critical (knockout if below the critical minimum)
expectedDepthPlaceholder: Seniority-relative anchor for "3 — Meets Expected Level" on this competency, e.g. "Explains WHY, not just HOW; architecture-level trade-offs expected."
expectedDepthHelp: Read by the report/rubric display only — never changes how scores are calculated (plan §39.7).
requirementPlaceholder: e.g. Work authorization in the hiring country
descriptionPlaceholder: What counts as demonstrated/not demonstrated for this requirement.
knockoutGateNote: A boolean knockout gate, not a scored competency (plan §4.3/§19) — if marked “not met” during an interview it fails the candidate independent of overall score.
questionTextPlaceholder: What is the question the interviewer asks?
altSolutionsPlaceholder: Other valid approaches besides the primary solution...
requiresTechnicalKnowledgeCheckboxLabel: Requires technical knowledge to evaluate (rare — usually belongs in Technical Interview instead)
technicalTermHelperLabel: Technical term helper (for a non-technical interviewer)
technicalTermHelperPlaceholder: e.g. "Kubernetes is commonly used to deploy and manage containerized applications. Focus on professional usage, duration, and responsibility — not technical correctness."
editableNotePublished: Published — no longer editable. Create a new version to make changes.
editableNoteLocked: Locked — a candidate session references this exact version. Create a new version to make changes.
